title: No Item Merge
description: Prevents dropped item entities from merging into larger stacks while keeping inventory stacking unchanged.
body:
No Item Merge is a small server-side Fabric mod that prevents dropped item entities from merging into larger stacks.

It only affects items dropped in the world. Inventory stacking is not changed.

Useful for maps, minigames, technical setups, recording, testing, or servers where every dropped item should stay separate.
